skill.name: blog-creator
skill.description: Create SEO-optimized MDX blog posts with structured frontmatter, tags, image paths, and publishing conventions.
skill.summary: Draft structured MDX blog posts for a documented content workflow.
skill.author: AayushBaniya2006

content.value_statement: Publishing MDX blog posts requires consistent frontmatter, image paths, tags, and metadata. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create posts that match the project workflow.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of MDX blog files under src/content/blog.
Defines frontmatter fields for title, tags, featured image, created date, and description.
Recommends kebab-case filenames that become blog slugs.
Describes image placement under public/assets/images and absolute asset paths.
Shows Markdown structure with frontmatter, title, introduction, and sections.
Explains SEO usage for titles, descriptions, and featured images.
limitations: It does not create image assets by itself.
It assumes the host project uses the documented MDX blog engine.
It does not run build, lint, or validation commands.
It does not verify factual claims or source accuracy.

use_cases.title: Publish Product Updates
use_cases.description: Create a formatted MDX post for a feature launch, release note, or company update.

use_cases.title: Standardize Blog Drafts
use_cases.description: Turn article notes into the required frontmatter and Markdown structure before editorial review.

use_cases.title: Write Developer Tutorials
use_cases.description: Prepare tutorial posts that follow the site slug, tag, and image conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one new article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an MDX blog post about [topic]. Use a clear title, 3 to 5 tags, a publication date, and a short SEO description.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Draft Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn existing notes into the required blog format.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these notes into an MDX blog post. Add frontmatter, improve headings, and suggest a kebab-case filename: [draft notes].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Launch Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a launch blog post for [product or feature]. Include SEO metadata, relevant tags, a featured image path, and a concise introduction.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Content Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request aligned with site publishing conventions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete MDX article for [audience] about [topic]. Include frontmatter, slug recommendation, section outline, SEO description, and image path guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a getting-started article for a SaaS starter kit.
output_examples.output: A complete article draft with metadata, a recommended slug, setup sections, relevant tags, and a featured image path.

output_examples.input: Turn release notes into a blog announcement.
output_examples.output: A polished announcement with launch context, feature sections, SEO description, and publishing metadata.

output_examples.input: Format my tutorial draft for the blog engine.
output_examples.output: A cleaned tutorial structure with frontmatter, consistent headings, corrected image references, and publication-ready Markdown.

best_practices: Use kebab-case filenames so generated slugs stay predictable.
Choose 3 to 5 focused tags that support related article logic.
Review metadata, links, claims, and MDX components before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use single quotes in frontmatter when the project expects double quotes.
Do not place image references outside the documented public asset path.
Do not publish generated factual claims without source review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates MDX blog post drafts with frontmatter, tags, image paths, dates, descriptions, and Markdown sections.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it create images?
faq.answer: No. It can guide image placement and references, but it does not generate image assets.

faq.question: Does it run validation commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation does not define build, lint, test, or validation commands.

faq.question: How should filenames be chosen?
faq.answer: Use kebab-case filenames because the filename becomes the blog slug.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review metadata accuracy, factual claims, image paths, tags, links, and any MDX components.
